exposure: Adherence to the quality cycle stages
outcome: Estimated time and costs for data collection
cohort: The study analyzed 1768 completed quality activities over a 5-year period (2015-2019) in a large Australian tertiary hospital.
finding: The study found no clear association between the number of completed quality activities and overall hospital-acquired complication performance, with implementing change and sustaining improvement identified as challenging stages in the quality cycle.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively for quality activities completed over a 5-year period (2015-2019).
